parties_primary_type_matches_role.name: parties_primary_type_matches_role
parties_primary_type_matches_role.value:
("parties"."primary_type" = 'customer' AND "parties"."is_customer")
       OR ("parties"."primary_type" = 'supplier' AND "parties"."is_supplier")
       OR ("parties"."primary_type" = 'employee' AND "parties"."is_employee")
       OR ("parties"."primary_type" = 'other')

stock_requests_customer_required_unless_.name: stock_requests_customer_required_unless_internal
stock_requests_customer_required_unless_.value:
("stock_requests"."request_type" IN ('internal', 'employee_borrow'))
          OR ("stock_requests"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "stock_requests"."customer_name_at_request" IS NOT NULL)

weighbridge_tickets_weights_non_negative.name: weighbridge_tickets_weights_non_negative
weighbridge_tickets_weights_non_negative.value:
("weighbridge_tickets"."first_weight" IS NULL OR "weighbridge_tickets"."first_weight" >= 0)
          AND ("weighbridge_tickets"."second_weight" IS NULL OR "weighbridge_tickets"."second_weight" >= 0)
